subject.title: [Feature]: Allow job-level model override for cron jobs using sessionTarget=main + payload.kind=systemEvent

question: Should main-session `systemEvent` cron jobs gain a supported model/provider override contract, and should that contract be `payload.model`, job-level fields, or an explicit `sessionOverride` block?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public cron API shape, provider/model precedence, persisted cron rows, and main-session state behavior, so automation should not choose the contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Extend `systemEvent` payload.model
options.body: Add model/provider override support to explicit `systemEvent` payloads as the narrowest extension of the existing cron payload model contract.

options.title: Add job-level override fields
options.body: Introduce top-level `model`/`provider` or `sessionOverride` fields that apply across payload kinds, accepting a broader persisted API and UI/docs surface.

options.title: Keep system events session-bound
options.body: Document isolated `agentTurn` jobs and explicit session model selection as the supported recurring-model paths and leave main-session system events tied to session state.

recommendation.title: Extend `systemEvent` payload.model
recommendation.body: Add model/provider override support to explicit `systemEvent` payloads as the narrowest extension of the existing cron payload model contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across cron runtime, session-target semantics, and adjacent model-routing contract work.
